description: This PHP class allows certain Composer Stager preconditions to be bypassed, specifically for package management operations within Drupal. It implements interfaces to bypass checks like directory differences and rsync availability, with methods to activate bypass, retrieve status messages, and check fulfillment.

classes.name: DirectWritePreconditionBypass
classes.description: A final class that implements precondition bypass logic for Composer Stager, allowing certain checks to be skipped in direct-write mode.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the bypass, setting the static flag to true.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the decorated precondition.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the decorated precondition.

methods.name: getStatusMessage
methods.description: Returns a status message indicating the precondition has been skipped if bypassed, otherwise delegates to the decorated precondition.

methods.name: isFulfilled
methods.description: Returns true if bypassed, otherwise checks if the decorated precondition is fulfilled.

methods.name: assertIsFulfilled
methods.description: Does nothing if bypassed, otherwise asserts the decorated precondition is fulfilled.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns an array containing this object, representing the leaves in the precondition chain.
